We need to propose a retrosynthesis route (max 3 steps) to target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

So target is a sulfonamide linking a tolyl (para methyl phenyl) to a phenyl sulfonyl attached to a trans-α,β-unsaturated amide attached to an aniline (para amino phenyl). Actually structure: p-methyl phenyl-sulfonyl attached to phenyl which has a trans-CH=CH-CO-NH-phenyl-NH2? Wait: The amide is attached to an aniline (Nc3ccccc3N) meaning an aniline with an amino group at para? Actually Nc3ccccc3N is an aniline with two amino groups? It's an aniline (aniline with an extra NH2 at para? Actually c3ccccc3 is phenyl, N attached to it (NH-Ph) and also the phenyl has an NH2 substituent? The SMILES: Nc3ccccc3N means an aniline with an amino at position 1 (attached to N) and another amino at position? Actually "Nc3ccccc3N" means N attached to aromatic carbon (position 1) and also the aromatic carbon at position 6 has N? The SMILES: N c3 c c c c c3 N. So there are two amino groups para to each other? The ring has N at both ends? That is 1,4-diaminobenzene (p-phenylenediamine) attached via amide to the unsaturated chain.

Thus target is fairly complex. We need to break it into commercially available precursors within 3 steps.

Potential disconnections:

1. Sulfonamide formation: combine p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride (or p-tolyl sulfonyl fluoride) with an aniline (the phenyl-sulfonyl part). Actually the sulfonamide is between p-tolyl amine? Wait the sulfonamide is NS(=O)(=O) attached to p-tolyl ring (the N is attached to the tolyl ring). The SMILES: Cc1ccc(N S(=O)(=O) c2ccc(... )cc2)cc1. So the sulfonamide nitrogen is attached to the tolyl ring (an aniline). So we need p-toluidine (4-methyl aniline) reacting with sulfonyl chloride derived from the other phenyl sulfonyl group (the sulfonyl attached to phenyl with unsaturated amide). So we can make sulfonyl chloride from 4-(trans-... ) phenyl sulfonyl chloride? Actually the sulfonyl group is attached to phenyl ring (c2ccc(... )cc2). So we need 4-(substituted) benzenesulfonyl chloride.

Thus step 1: Sulfonyl chloride synthesis: Starting from 4-(trans-... ) benzenesulfonic acid (or sulfonyl chloride). Could be made by chlorosulfonation of the phenyl ring (commercially available 4-(trans-... ) phenyl? Not likely.

Alternative: Build the sulfonamide later: first make the unsaturated amide attached to aniline (p-phenylenediamine). Then sulfonylate the other aniline (p-toluidine) with sulfonyl chloride derived from the phenyl-sulfonyl part.

Maybe easier: Use two commercially available building blocks: p-toluidine (4-methyl aniline) and 4-(trans-... ) benzenesulfonyl chloride (maybe not commercially available). Could we use 4-bromobenzenesulfonyl chloride and then do Suzuki coupling to attach the unsaturated amide phenyl? That would be more steps.

We have limit 3 steps, so we need a concise route.

Potential route:

Step A (retrosynthesis): Disconnection at sulfonamide N-S bond. Precursors: p-toluidine (commercial) and 4-(trans-... ) benzenesulfonyl chloride (maybe commercially available). Check if that sulfonyl chloride is available. Search.
